name: nanogram per milliliter per day
parent: units not in UO; UO:0000280 rate unit
definition: nanogram per milliliter per day (synonym ng/mL/day).

name: biomass production rate
definition: Rate at which new microbial biomass is produced in a sample, as mass of an element (usually carbon) per volume per time; for example heterotrophic production estimated from 3H-leucine incorporation into protein. Related synonym: heterotrophic production.

name: time since sample collection
definition: Time between the collection of a sample and a later step applied to it, such as the start of an incubation, fixation or analysis.
